reviewed_sources.title: Is Spreadsheet Ambiguity Harmful? Detecting and Repairing Spreadsheet Smells due to Ambiguous Computation
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Operational abstention when perturbation evidence cannot isolate one source is distinct from heterogeneous formula patterns inside a cell array.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Spreadsheet ambiguity, cell-array formula-pattern inference, or synthesized repair is new.

reviewed_sources.title: Error Trapping and Metamorphic Testing for Spreadsheet Failure Detection
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Evaluate a fixed role-conditioned perturbation protocol, complete source ranking, directed downstream recovery, and explicit selective action against preregistered baselines.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Applying metamorphic testing to spreadsheets, detecting failures without expected outputs, or using source/follow-up input transformations is new.

reviewed_sources.title: SEDMR: A Spreadsheet Error Detection Approach Based on Metamorphic Testing
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Compare V5-PSL's complete source ranking, directed downstream recovery, identifiability states, and fixed review budget with SEDMR's relation-based error marking.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Oracle-free spreadsheet detection, input or formula-pattern perturbation, metamorphic relation combination, cell-array role structure, or error-cell marking is new.

reviewed_sources.title: On the Effectiveness of Automatically Inferred Invariants in Detecting Regression Faults in Spreadsheets
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: V5-PSL uses fixed role-conditioned response comparisons rather than Daikon invariants learned from an earlier sufficiently correct version.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Spreadsheet invariants, internal consistency relations, or invariant-violation testing is new.

reviewed_sources.title: Domain Invariant-Based Spreadsheet Debugging
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Disclose that full text was unavailable and use Roy et al. 2018 as the required full-text invariant-debugging anchor.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Using domain invariants for spreadsheet error detection or repair is new, or the unavailable source establishes V5-PSL novelty or superiority.

reviewed_sources.title: CUSTODES: Automatic Spreadsheet Cell Clustering and Smell Detection Using Strong and Weak Features
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Compare static formula-cluster outliers with a source ranking conditioned on complete perturbation responses.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Formula roles, AST/reference clustering, weak layout features, minority outliers, or spreadsheet smell ranking is new.

reviewed_sources.title: ExceLint: Automatically Finding Spreadsheet Formula Errors
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Test whether controlled response and directed downstream evidence adds source-localization information beyond ExceLint-like static ranking.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Oracle-free formula detection, relative-reference fingerprints, rectangular formula regions, candidate fixes, or ranked review is new.

reviewed_sources.title: WARDER: Refining Cell Clustering for Effective Spreadsheet Defect Detection via Validity Properties
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Treat WARDER-like role validity as a static baseline and measure the incremental effect of response conditioning and selective action.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Validity-based cell-cluster refinement or missing/inconsistent formula detection is new.

reviewed_sources.title: On the Empirical Evaluation of Fault Localization Techniques for Spreadsheets
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: V5-PSL studies complete source ranking without expected outputs, pass/fail tokens, or user-marked failing cells.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Spreadsheet fault localization, dependency-cone root-cause ranking, or suspicious-cell ranking is new.

reviewed_sources.title: Fragment-Based Spreadsheet Debugging
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Compare a no-expected-output cell ranking and fixed one/five/zero action budget with fragment testing that obtains user annotations.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Reducing spreadsheet debugging effort through ranked review or human-in-the-loop fault localization is new.

reviewed_sources.title: Mutation-Based Spreadsheet Debugging
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Disclose that full text was unavailable and use Fariha et al. 2020 as the required full-text interventional-debugging anchor.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Candidate mutation, automatic spreadsheet repair, genetic-programming spreadsheet debugging, or repair search is new, or the unavailable source establishes V5-PSL novelty or superiority.

reviewed_sources.title: Causality-Guided Adaptive Interventional Debugging
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Evaluate fixed role-conditioned response interventions for a single workbook without successful/failed execution labels.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Interventional debugging, counterfactual root-cause reasoning, active intervention, or causal explanation paths is new.

reviewed_sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
reviewed_sources.permitted_claim: Instantiate selective risk, coverage, and explicit review cost for spreadsheet source localization.
reviewed_sources.forbidden_claim: Abstention, reject options, risk-coverage analysis, or expert handling of rejected cases is new.

note: Passed under the v3 access amendment: 11 required primary sources have full-text reviews, while two closed-access direct neighbors remain explicitly disclosed and permanently constrain novelty claims. Copyrighted artifacts and review notes remain outside Git.
